mathematics.assertion_tested: Tree photon-carrier scattering and local vacuum photonic-width estimate at the assigned optical benchmark
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Double precision quadrature and explicit physical polarization sums
mathematics.conventions: Stationary free carrier, Born scattering, independent beam photon flux; nonrelativistic local mediator decay width
non_claims: No total photon-induced loss bound, stimulated sideband analysis, cavity density of states or material absorption
Vacuum-width estimate is not a spontaneous decay measurement
Recoil ejection is an impulse approximation, not a finite-shell transition calculation
